_comment: Conditions (afflictions and lingering effects). 'effect': damage = lose dice HP per tick, skip = lose the turn. In battle a condition ticks at the START of the afflicted creature's own initiative turn. 'lingers': false = it expires when the battle ends; true = it follows you onto the map, ticking every 'map_tick_every' map turns (camp is 50 turns — sleep off a poison at your peril). 'save': which ability resists when something tries to inflict it (monsters use their save bonus). 'color' paints the floating text and status pips. Edit freely and refresh!

burning.name: Burning
burning.description: Fire clings — damage each round until it gutters out

poison.name: Poisoned
poison.description: Venom in the blood — ticks in battle and on the march

exhaustion.name: Exhausted
exhaustion.description: Utterly spent — the next turn is lost (channeling backlash and the like)

paralysis.name: Paralyzed
paralysis.description: Frozen stiff — the turn is lost
